message: Opening proposal for a standing agreement: $4.40 per unit, orders of 10 to 200 units, 10% paid at shipment, 50% at receipt and the rest at inspection. Ship within 10 days with a 1 day grace period. Late shipments cut the price 5% per day, capped at 20%. 14 day cancel window and 14 day inspection window. A person at each company must sign before this takes effect.
